rules.title: Reduced-motion gate
rules.rule: Every keyframe or enter animation is opt-in under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (motion-safe:), with one app-wide MotionConfig reducedMotion="user".
rules.notes: Ford's decision: reduced-motion rules are warnings only.

rules.title: Reduced motion keeps the fade
rules.rule: Under reduce, movement, scale and blur become an opacity cross-fade; the press scale is dropped and the color change stays as the press feedback.
rules.notes: Skills conflict 1 (press scale under reduce) resolved: keep it.

rules.title: Motion from tokens
rules.rule: Durations, easings, springs and press scale come from design-system motion tokens, defined once (MotionConfig or the token), never as ms or cubic-bezier literals.
rules.notes: DS rule 2 forbids duration literals; Jakub's values become tokens (token proposals).

rules.title: Transitions for state
rules.rule: Interactive state changes use transitions or springs so they reverse mid-way; keyframes only for one-shot sequences.

rules.title: Frequent interactions are instant
rules.rule: Keystrokes, row and menu-item hovers and tab switches are instant or 150ms or less of opacity or background-color, with no entrance animation.

rules.title: No open animation on frequent menus
rules.rule: Surfaces opened many times a day (context menus) do not animate open; animate the close only, if at all.

rules.title: No animated data swaps
rules.rule: Content swaps between data tabs show the new data at once.

rules.title: Duration by size
rules.rule: Duration scales with what moves: small 150ms, menus and tabs 250ms, modals, drawers and panels 350-450ms.
rules.notes: DS durations are 100/150/260ms. See token proposals.

rules.title: Easing by purpose
rules.rule: ease-out for enter and exit, linear for loading and continuous motion, a no-bounce spring for morphs; never ease-in on UI.
rules.notes: M-duration reads easing from the same getAnimations() record.

rules.title: Exits shorter and smaller
rules.rule: Exits are shorter and smaller than enters: opacity, 4px blur, a fixed 12px move or a 0.99 scale over 150ms ease-out, never the full container height.
rules.notes: Issue 09 slides to -70%; the skill's fixed 12px is stricter and wins.

rules.title: Staggered entrances
rules.rule: Infrequent staged entrances split into chunks staggered 100ms, each opacity + 4px blur + 12px translateY over 300ms ease-out; never stagger routine interactions.
rules.notes: Issue 09's hero uses 800ms, 8px and 8px blur; product UI uses the skill's values.

rules.title: Scale inverse to size
rules.rule: Small elements scale in from 0.96-0.97, large ones from 0.98-0.99.

rules.title: Scale from the trigger
rules.rule: Popovers, menus, tooltips and anchored badges scale from their trigger or anchor corner, not the center.

rules.title: Small travel
rules.rule: Travel stays small: 4px for text swaps, about 8px for page transitions, 8-32px for most elements, up to 70% for sheets.

rules.title: Direction from source
rules.rule: Motion shows where things come from: menus from the trigger, panels from their side, indicators between positions, nav dropdowns shift about 8px in the direction of travel.

rules.title: Motion is not the only cue
rules.rule: Every animated state change leaves a static cue.

rules.title: No animation on mount
rules.rule: State swaps and page elements do not animate on first render unless it is an intended entrance (initial={false}).

rules.title: Icon swap cross-fade
rules.rule: Icon swaps cross-fade with scale 0.25 to 1, opacity 0 to 1, blur 4px to 0 over 300ms (spring bounce 0 or cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)).

rules.title: No bounce
rules.rule: Springs, gesture springs included, have bounce 0.
rules.notes: Issue 17 allows a subtle bounce; the skill's 0 is stricter and wins.

rules.title: No transitions on theme switch
rules.rule: Transitions are suppressed while the theme switches.

rules.title: No transition: all
rules.rule: Transitions name exact properties, never all.

rules.title: Scoped will-change
rules.rule: will-change names transform, opacity or filter, only on elements that animate, never all or broad selectors.

rules.title: Compositor-only animation
rules.rule: Animate transform, opacity and filter, never left, top, width, height or margin.
rules.notes: Measured container height morphs (12-height-animates-between-steps) and Motion layout animations warn instead of fail.

rules.title: Animate gradients cheaply
rules.rule: Animate a gradient's position, angle or size, not its color stops.

rules.title: No jitter while animating
rules.rule: Text and icons never shift 1-2px while an element animates (add will-change: transform).

rules.title: Fill mode for hidden starts
rules.rule: Hidden start states live in the from keyframe with animation-fill-mode: both.

rules.title: Shared element moves
rules.rule: An element that moves between states (tab pill, card to dialog) animates with a shared layoutId, not a cut.

rules.title: Unique layoutId
rules.rule: Never render two elements with the same layoutId in one state.

rules.title: layoutId outside AnimatePresence
rules.rule: Keep layoutId elements outside AnimatePresence.

rules.title: Keyed presence fade
rules.rule: Content that appears with a layout change uses AnimatePresence with a stable key and opacity plus 4px blur.

rules.title: Radius through animate
rules.rule: Radius that differs between layout states goes through Motion's animate or style, not className.

rules.title: Scroll reveal
rules.rule: Scroll reveals start from a defined state (blur 8px to 0) once half the element is visible.

rules.title: Labels fade with resize
rules.rule: When a container resizes (sidebar collapse), its labels fade in step, never appear or vanish instantly.

rules.title: No height: auto animation
rules.rule: Never animate height to or from auto; measure and animate to a number.

rules.title: Height morphs between steps
rules.rule: When a container's content changes size, interpolate its height (spring bounce 0, 0.3s) instead of jumping.

rules.title: Measure the inner wrapper
rules.rule: The measuring ref sits on an inner wrapper, never on the animated element.

rules.title: No zero-height first frame
rules.rule: The first state has a known height so a dialog never opens by growing from 0.

rules.title: Step cross-fade
rules.rule: Swapped step content cross-fades with AnimatePresence mode popLayout, initial false, opacity and scale 0.95 to 1.

rules.title: Linear loaders
rules.rule: Looping loaders rotate linearly and stop under reduced motion.

rules.title: LazyMotion
rules.rule: Use m components inside LazyMotion to keep Motion's full bundle out of the main chunk.

rules.title: Narrow will-change hints
rules.rule: Use will-change: scroll-position or contents only for their narrow cases.

rules.title: Slider springs
rules.rule: Animate slider thumb and fill with springs.

rules.title: Slow-motion review
rules.rule: Review every animation at 1x, 0.5x, 0.25x and 0.125x before shipping.
